subject.title: feat(memory-lancedb): per-agent / per-channel scoping for autoCapture and autoRecall

question: Should memory-lancedb add a plugin-owned per-agent/per-channel ambient autoCapture/autoRecall config surface now, or should this stay folded into the canonical memory isolation/security design?
rationale: The request defines a persistent memory security boundary and new config/default behavior, and current code plus prior related PRs show unresolved migration, deletion, and live-proof semantics that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Fold Into Canonical Isolation Design
options.body: Keep this issue open as design input for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/83437 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/63550 so one approved memory-boundary model covers auto capture, auto recall, tools, legacy rows, and proof.

options.title: Sponsor Narrow Plugin Config
options.body: Approve a focused memory-lancedb config design for per-agent/per-channel ambient gates, with explicit defaults, docs, upgrade behavior, and live proof requirements before implementation.

options.title: Document Existing Recall Workaround
options.body: Use Active Memory's per-agent/chat-id gating for recall-only deployments and recommend disabling memory-lancedb autoCapture/autoRecall globally in sensitive channels until structural scoping lands.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Canonical Isolation Design
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as design input for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/83437 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/63550 so one approved memory-boundary model covers auto capture, auto recall, tools, legacy rows, and proof.
